notes.title: New version is now live 0.9.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Added ragdoll stun;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new weapon: Harpoon;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new tattoos;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for BoxGlove;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for Mortar;[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new coloring variations for Harpoon;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new player movement animations;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher) Increased reload speed by 30%;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher \\ Mortar, RMB) Increased AoE force after rocket jump by 20%;[/p][/*][*][p](Rocket Launcher \\ Mortar, RMB) Reduced hit player's air launch height after a rocket jump by 26%;[/p][/*][*][p](Black Hole Generator, LMB) Increased black hole activation distance to 8 meters;[/p][/*][*][p](Box Glove) Reduced dash speed by 5%;[/p][/*][*][p](Booster "Acceleration") Increased acceleration speed by 25%;[/p][/*][*][p](Booster "Acceleration") Reduced acceleration duration to 4 seconds;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased round duration on some maps;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where run VFX can be appear in the air;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where player could move by inertia after respawning;[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/d600909f50d616782caaec0d954ab4f5ea0ae68d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/cf7cc6dfe38868e2074962c20d3643e7b064a49e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41344682/4b532df1fee1bc716200784460a5cc02ed165ba5.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: Added 3 new coloring variations for BoxGlove;
Added 3 new coloring variations for Mortar;

tags.balance_change: (Rocket Launcher \ Mortar, RMB) Increased AoE force after rocket jump by 20%;
(Rocket Launcher \ Mortar, RMB) Reduced hit player's air launch height after a rocket jump by 26%;
(Black Hole Generator, LMB) Increased black hole activation distance to 8 meters;
Increased round duration on some maps;

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where run VFX can be appear in the air;
Fixed a bug where player could move by inertia after respawning;
